items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Oh, she had a wonderful voice.

ctx.x: No. It's very remarkable. Well, Cootie, then 1968 was that second Sacred Concert at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine. I just wanted to talk to you about that beautiful voice, Alice Babbs. Surely you love that voice, don't you?
Yeah. Oh, she had a wonderful voice. A terrific voice.
Don't you think that what she had was something that absolutely belonged in there with the band? That sound. Or do you?
